readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
The temple struck eleven, after which Lina was still in the kitchen
When the hall clock struck eleven

durations: Madame's piano played for thirteen minutes, from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen at the start of the evening, drying the toast glasses
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock
Fräulein Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Madame's piano was heard playing from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock, so Madame was at the piano
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier to fetch the master for the toast
The master was in the atelier, lying on the floor
Rosa opened the atelier door and went into the atelier
